facts.label: Honors
facts.value: Halise Teyze's red-lentil soup, presented in her memory

story: My mom is an extraordinary cook, and her recipes lived where family recipes always live — in her head, in gestures, in “a handful of this.” Annemin Tarifleri (“My Mother's Recipes”) is my attempt to pin them down before they drift: the lentil soup, the orzo chicken soup, the stuffed peppers, each one documented the way she actually makes it.

Every recipe gets a full video walkthrough, narrated in five languages — forty videos total. The narration isn't a recipe card being read aloud; it's written to feel like standing in her kitchen. One page honors my late aunt Halise Teyze, whose red-lentil soup reached me through my mom.
It's a heritage project disguised as a recipe site — and a serious content-production pipeline: recipe development, filming, editing, and multilingual voiceover, all produced by me.
tagline: A recipe site preserving my mother's cooking in 5 languages.
title: Annemin Tarifleri
